title: Malicious code in exploring_the_nikon_z6ii_z7ii_a_complete_digital_by_katherin_stuessy_2fszs (npm)
description: The npm package 'exploring_the_nikon_z6ii_z7ii_a_complete_digital_by_katherin_stuessy_2fszs' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
